config.name: Abri Korte Friendly Rally
config.title: Friendly Rally
config.blurb: Our first ever Friendly Rally: beginner friendly fun play, with free snacks and water for every player. Sign up solo or as a pair. Solo players get paired with another beginner.
config.hoursNote: Prize court hours never expire and can be used any time. Want cash instead? We'll help you sell them to our regular players. Every player also gets free snacks and water.

results.blurb: Our first Friendly Rally is a wrap: 15 beginner teams, four pools and a full Sunday of friendly games. Congratulations to our champions, Mark M. and Klever!

t14.alt: The champions, Mark M. and Klever, with their medals

t16.alt: Marjo and Vracks with their 2nd place medals

t9.alt: A 3rd place medal for Alfie and Kabatanya

results.thanks: Salamat to every player, the crew who kept the snacks coming, and everyone who came to cheer. See you at the next rally!
